data.body:
[P2] Preserve service-requested suspension across deadline expiry

If a checkpoint response withdraws `CheckpointToken` and `onInvocationEnd` subsequently exceeds the invocation budget, `runHandler` has selected `PENDING`, but this catch rethrows `InvocationDeadlineError`. That bypasses the existing revoked-token precedence and makes Lambda retry an invocation whose token is already unusable. Record service-requested suspension in the lifecycle and preserve its `PENDING` response on expiry, alongside the acknowledged-result exception. Add a regression that holds `onInvocationEnd` past the deadline after token withdrawal.
